title: Scheduling: Book, Confirm, Move and Cancel Appointments | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Your staff book appointments for customers by phone, in person or by email. The Scheduling module for Orchard Core lets them book an open time, confirm a request, move an appointment, cancel it and close it, with every change on the resource's calendar.

This video shows each of those steps on screen.

In this video:
• The statuses of an appointment: held, requested, confirmed, completed, no-show, cancelled and expired
• Booking an appointment for a customer from an appointment type
• Managing it: the customer's manage link, confirm, took place, no-show, move and cancel
• The appointments list with its search and status filter
• How appointments show on the resource's calendar

chapters.title: Book an appointment for a customer
